summary: Identifies common kinds of DNS queries to which some servers fail to respond or respond incorrectly, causing operational problems and holding back protocol development. It explains why these behaviors are harmful and what servers should do instead. It is a best current practice.

eli5.summary: DNS works like asking a question and getting an answer. Some servers stay silent or answer wrongly when asked unusual questions. This document lists such cases and explains why servers should reply properly.

questions: why do some dns servers not respond
what are common dns server failures to respond
